sloka: प्रसादयाम् आस पुनः कैकेयीम् च इदम् अब्रवीत् ।साधु व्Rत्तस्य दीनस्य त्वद् गतस्य गत आयुषः ॥२-१३-२०॥
transliteration: prasādayām āsa punaḥ kaikeyīm ca idam abravīt ।sādhu vRttasya dīnasya tvad gatasya gata āyuṣaḥ ॥2-13-20॥

translations.english: O gentle queen, I am an old man and my life is almost over. I am a wretch devoted to you. I am a man of good conduct. Do me this favour especially as I am king.
